Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack is sitting on a bed, staring at the floor, his hands clenched into fists 💪.

DR. SMITH:
Alright, Jack, it's time for your medication. You know the drill 📚.

JACK:
I don't want to take them! They're poison! 💔

DR. SMITH:
(sighing) Jack, you need these pills to manage your symptoms. They're safe, I promise 🙏.

JACK:
I don't believe you! You're just trying to control me! 🚫

DR. SMITH:
(frustrated) Jack, listen to me. I've been treating you for months. I know what's best for you 🤝.

JACK:
(getting up from the bed) I won't take them! You can't make me! 💥

DR. SMITH:
(firmly) Jack, please. Just take the pills. I'll even give you a lollipop to make it easier 🍭.

JACK:
(sneering) You think a lollipop is going to make me take my medicine? Ha! 🤣

DR. SMITH:
(exasperated) Fine. If you won't take them, then I'll take them myself. (he picks up the pills and forces them into his mouth) Ah, that's better 🤮.

As Dr. Smith swallows the pills, he looks up, expecting to see Jack still sitting on the bed. But instead, he sees... nothing 🌀.

DR. SMITH:
(confused) Where's Jack?

He looks around the room, but there's no sign of his patient. Suddenly, the room begins to distort and blur, like a painting melting in the rain 🌂.

DR. SMITH:
(alarmed) What's happening?

The room continues to distort, and Dr. Smith's vision begins to break down. He sees Jack's face, but it's not really there. It's just a figment of his imagination, a manifestation of his own paranoid delusions 🤯.

DR. SMITH:
(terrified) Oh no... I'm the one who's been delusional all along...

The camera zooms out, and we see that Dr. Smith is sitting in a padded cell, surrounded by the walls of his own mind 🚪. The pills he took are still clutched in his hand, a symbol of his own fragile mental state 💔.

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
